title: Periods Billed in Advance with a ShieldCare Premium Invoice
content:
Periods ahead of the invoiced period may be billed in advance with a premium invoice on a Northbeam
ShieldCare Protection Plan. The number turns on whether a purchase order is required on the store credit
account the profile holds under Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts, and on how much cover the
plan has left to run, counted in whole months from today to the plan's coverage end day.

| What the records show | The periods billed in advance |
| --- | --- |
| a purchase order is required on the account, and the plan has more than 12 months of cover left to run | 2 periods |
| no purchase order is required on the account, and the plan has more than 12 months of cover left to run | 1 period |
| every other plan | no period is billed in advance with the invoice |

### Both sides of the cover threshold

More than 12 months of cover left to run means 13 whole months or more: a plan with exactly 12 whole
months left does not clear the threshold and no period is billed in advance, whether or not a purchase
order is required. Above the threshold, the purchase order requirement alone separates 2 periods from 1.

### Cases on hypothetical records

| Whole months of cover left | Purchase order required | Periods in advance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 | no | none |
| 12 | yes | none |
| 13 | yes | 2 |
| 30 | no | 1 |
| 30 | yes | 2 |
